# One ANO session against a live 26ai server requiring AES256 + SHA256 (a
# throwaway lab session): the DH shared secret, the server DH IV, and every
# DATA payload the server sent with its SHA-256 MAC, decrypted. "reset=1"
# marks a payload that came after a break/reset marker exchange (a SQL error
# with DISABLE_OOB): the data-integrity keystreams are re-derived before it.
enc=17 int=5

server_iv=666f6f206261722062617a206261742071757578
packet reset=0  mac=c65940f94191ac5e7685c0cf6a24a1334ebfe7c38683bea2bb0bae662681bc38
packet reset=0  mac=69bdeff52764e81463a6a19959e65bb37ed2e81a6fca58d8d98f619404f20797
packet reset=0  mac=67b067462f3992ceb2db8ac3e18b3830d46e8360dfe961660dbf1e3caab4cfe4
packet reset=0  mac=1d030a547b239da78e8478afd42440e20b92c80865745ffd56d315ab40a0ef4f
packet reset=1 payload=040101010f000203ae00000103010e03000000000000000000000000040000000000000203ae00010300434f52412d30303934323a207461626c65206f722076696577202250594f222e22534545525f4e4f5f535543485f5441424c452220646f6573206e6f742065786973740a1d mac=815ecb972944c04fed31fd9cd3f4a7e396eec6c40b416e37592af9bff76bf283
